description: DESTEST supplies common district-energy test exercises, reference inputs, participant results and a Python time-series comparison tool. It supports cross-tool verification of building clusters and district heating or cooling networks. The provider is IBPSA Project 1 contributors. Coverage: Exercises range from individual buildings to clusters of hundreds. They define their own topology, weather and boundaries, not a single geographic inventory. Access: A public repository provides test descriptions, input files and comparison-tool documentation. No benchmark payload was downloaded. Licence and cost: The licence permits source and binary redistribution under revised BSD 3-Clause terms. An additional paragraph grants rights over voluntarily shared enhancements unless separately licensed. Limitations: Agreement among simulations is a comparison test, not proof of empirical accuracy. Licence scope and each exercise’s numerical resolution should be checked before reuse. For simulation it supplies structured comparison cases and output checks for district-energy models. Related resources: model-urbanopt-sdk is a separate district-energy modelling resource. DESTEST provides a benchmarking procedure, not an extension of that SDK.
